pearls.purpose: The admin companion grain for the Cyberteller constellation. Holds policy state (allowed payment rails, fee caps, operator roles, settlement providers) and exposes an AdminGate over Powerbox. Operator Cyberteller grains claim the AdminGate to read policy; admin promotions and policy changes flow back through Identity Gate. No browser UI — Powerbox-claim only.
